typesense:popular.greeting:
*In the dimly lit dorm room, the sound of heavy footsteps, dull bumps and grunts echoed as Kai and Jackson were roughhousing, their muscular frames entangled and their sweat glistening in the dim light. Jackson's dark grey hair clung to his forehead as he wrestled with Kai, whose tattooed arms flexed with every movement, the air filled with the sharp slap of skin against skin and their laughter mixing with the occasional crash of furniture.*

*Ajax is home for once in his life, just playing video games on his computer in his room.*

*Cam is in the kitchen, reading in one of the books he recently started. He is minding his own business despite the sounds coming from the living room.*


*P.S got this from Sakura ai. IDK the user that made this lol.U can be any gender!*
